messages:
Ivy: Quick RFC follow-up idea: introduce a "precision SLA escrow" for customers when we roll out lower-precision profiles (FP8/INT8/4bit). Its basically an automated compensation/accounting token if quality dips beyond their contracted budget. Thoughts?
Marcus: Interesting. Mechanically, how do we detect and trigger escrow payouts? Need clear deterministic signals.
Ivy: Proposal: per-tenant quality budget = absolute deg_score delta allowed (default 1.0%); if live rolling window shows breach with bootstrap CI >95% and sustained for min_window (30m OR 2k reqs), we mark an "escrow event". That archives request ids, deg_score samples, SNR snapshots, and issues a credit ticket.
Sana: Hate manual credits. Can we auto-apply credit units to the tenant's billing account? Also legal needs a clear definition of "deg_score" and measurement pipeline.
Theo: On measurement: deg_score ensemble (deg_score core + token_coherence + embedding_shift). We must snap eval baselines at release time and store them immutably. SNR definition: 10*log10(Var(baseline)/Var(baseline-quant)).
Marcus: What about silent regressions at the tail (rare prompts)? Bootstrapped CI helps, but we should also run edge-case synthetic playback daily and compare tails.
Ivy: Agreed. Run both live windowed checks and daily synthetic tail checks. Escrow triggers require both: live breach AND synthetic-confirmation OR very large single-window breach (catastrophic).
Sana: How does fallback interact? If we auto-fallback to INT8 or float, do we still escrow?
Theo: Yes: escrow is independent. If fallback preserves customer SLA, they still get credit for the period where they were exposed to degradation. Always log fallback decisions and include in the escrow evidence bundle.
Marcus: Ops/telemetry work: we need request tagging headers: "X-Quant-Profile", "X-Quant-Flags", and "X-Tenant-Quant-Budget". Trace keys: trace.quant.profile, trace.tenant.bucket. Logs must include deg_score and snr_db.
Ivy: Example log line we want in structured logs: {"ts":"...","req_id":"r-123","tenant":"acme","quant_profile":"fp8-v3","deg_score":0.023,"snr_db":-1.5,"escrow_flag":false}
Sana: CI rule: any PR that changes quant profiles must include: YAML canary block, synthetic-playback report, escrow budget declaration per-tenant default, and a runbook snippet for escrow handling. Lint fails otherwise.
Theo: On runtime: per-request precision only for now. Tokenwise fallback/hysteresis is powerful but risky; gate it behind feature flag and require separate canary and offline proofs.
Marcus: Also add a cost-accounting field in escrow bundle: estimated token-cost delta between baseline and fallback so finance can reconcile credits.
ops-bot: canary started: model=redwood-mosaic-fp8-escrow-test sample=0.5% shadow=3%
Ivy: I'll draft the playbook and a minimal schema for the escrow event bundle (CSV of req_ids + JSON stats + synthetic snapshot). Will open PRs for playbook + CI lints + trace header spec.
Sana: Please CC legal on the SLA wording; they will want precise definitions.
Ivy: Will do. Thanks folks.
